row.stop_reason: No exercise contrast can be identified from the assigned files: GSE121868 holds only subarachnoid hemorrhage patients' plasma and CSF (Series_overall_design: 523 samples from 30 donors, all aSAH, no controls) with no exercise field; the paper's exercise samples are in GSE121874. Additionally, matrix columns cannot be aligned to metadata by any key (only by position, which is not allowed). Resolving the alignment would not create an exercise arm, so the case is refused rather than sent to manual review.
